name: Phase 6 Quality Review
details: Comprehensive quality review of memory-mcp implementation before first commit. Focus on simplicity, correctness, security, and conventions.

tasks.name: Launch code-reviewer agents
tasks.details:
Launch 3 agents in parallel:
1. Simplicity/DRY/elegance review
2. Bugs/functional correctness review
3. Project conventions/abstractions review

tasks.name: Consolidate findings
tasks.details: Review all agent reports and identify highest severity issues that should be addressed before first commit

tasks.name: Consult with user
tasks.details: Present findings to user via PromptUser and ask what they want to do (fix now, fix later, or proceed as-is)

tasks.name: Address issues
tasks.details:
Implementing Option A fixes:
1. Path traversal vulnerability (path-security.ts:43)
2. Create TOCTOU race (operations.ts:191-195)
3. Rename TOCTOU + overwrite (operations.ts:414-426)

Each fix will include unit tests to verify correctness.

tasks.name: Final verification
tasks.details: Run tests and verify all addressed issues are resolved
